description.value: COBS Bread Willowbrook Park Bakery is a franchise location of the Canadian artisan-style bakery chain, part of the Bakers Delight family with over 190 locations across Canada. Everything is baked from scratch on-site each day, with no refrigeration or freezing of products, and leftovers are donated to local charities at closing. Touring cyclists will find a range of breads, rolls, bagels, scones, croissants, and savoury items like mini pizzas available fresh throughout the day.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for the Willowbrook Park Bakery location confirms the OSM phone number (+1 604-427-0388) and address (6233 200th St, Langley, BC V2Y 1A2) exactly. The store page shows regular daily hours and a 'Closed Opens tomorrow' real-time status indicator, confirming it is an operating business, not permanently closed. Neither the website nor OSM tags mention bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cyclist-specific amenities, so those are null; however, the website's product catalogue confirms fresh-baked bread, rolls, bagels, and other staples consistent with a basic groceries claim.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating bakery with confirmed address, phone, and regular hours. A useful food stop for touring cyclists seeking fresh bread and baked goods.
enrichment_extras.notes: The website showed 'Closed Opens tomorrow' at time of content fetch — this is a real-time open/closed status indicator, not a permanent closure signal.
